title: Crop Image
about: Crop photos and graphics with precise framing controls. Drag the selection to reposition it, resize its edges and corners, or enter exact X and Y coordinates and output dimensions in source pixels. Choose a free crop, square, common social-media and photo aspect ratios, or a circle, triangle or hexagon cutout. Processing runs locally in your browser; your original file is not changed.
steps: Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image up to the workspace limit, or drop it into the upload area.
Choose Free, 1:1 Square, 16:9, 9:16, 4:5, 4:3, 3:2, Triangle, Hexagon or Circle.
Drag inside the selection to move it. Drag a corner or edge handle to resize it; use the X, Y, Width and Height fields for exact pixel values.
Review the output dimensions and choose PNG, JPG or WebP for rectangular crops. Circle, triangle and hexagon crops export as PNG to preserve transparency.
Select Crop Image, inspect the result, then download your cropped copy. The source image remains unchanged.
capabilities: The Crop Image workspace supports freeform rectangular cropping, square cropping, 16:9 landscape, 9:16 portrait, 4:5 portrait, 4:3 and 3:2 aspect ratios, plus circular, triangular and hexagonal transparent cutouts. The selection can be moved and resized with pointer or touch input. Exact X position, Y position, width and height are available in source-image pixels. Rectangular crops can be exported as PNG, JPG or WebP; lossy formats include a quality control. Shaped crops export as PNG to preserve transparent exterior pixels. Cropping and encoding use the browser Canvas API on the user's device.
benefits: Prepare profile pictures, social posts, stories, thumbnails, product images, document photos and creative assets with a consistent frame. Aspect-ratio presets reduce unwanted platform cropping, while exact pixel controls help match required dimensions. Transparent shape exports are useful for profile graphics, stickers and layered designs.
limitations: Cropping removes pixels outside the selected area; it does not enlarge or sharpen the remaining image. The output cannot contain more source detail than the selected region. JPG does not support transparency, so circle, triangle and hexagon exports are PNG. Large images may take longer to process depending on browser memory and device performance. The original file is not overwritten.

faqs.question: Can I crop to an exact pixel size?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter the X position, Y position, width and height in pixels. The selection and output dimensions update to match the values within the source image boundaries.

faqs.question: Which aspect ratios are available?
faqs.answer: Free, 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:5, 4:3 and 3:2 are available, along with triangle, hexagon and circle shapes.

faqs.question: Can I move and resize the crop area?
faqs.answer: Yes. Drag inside the selected frame to move it. Drag its edge or corner handles to resize it. You can also focus the frame and use the arrow keys for precise movement; hold Shift to move in larger steps.

faqs.question: Can I download a circular or shaped crop with transparent corners?
faqs.answer: Yes. Circle, triangle and hexagon crops are exported as PNG so the pixels outside the shape remain transparent.

faqs.question: Which output formats can I use?
faqs.answer: Rectangular crops support PNG, JPG and WebP. PNG preserves image data without lossy compression, while JPG and WebP offer adjustable quality. Shaped crops use PNG for transparency.

faqs.question: Does cropping change my original image?
faqs.answer: No. BROBEX creates a separate cropped download in your browser. Your original file remains unchanged.

faqs.question: Does cropping improve image quality?
faqs.answer: No. Cropping changes the framing by removing pixels around the selected area. It does not add detail or increase resolution.
